entries.label: WHY_YOU_HERE_1
entries.body:
we are the chenjesu... we are the mmrnmhrm
we do not understand how you have penetrated the slave shield or why
but in doing so you have interrupted the process
explain this intrusion.
entries.source:
we are the chenjesu... we are the mmrnmhrm
we do not understand how you have penetrated the slave shield or why
but in doing so you have interrupted the process
explain this intrusion.
entries.translation:
我們是陳傑蘇…… 我們是姆爾恩姆赫姆
我們不明白你如何穿透奴役 護盾，也不明白原因
但你的行動中斷了進程
請解釋這次入侵。

entries.label: WHY_YOU_HERE_2
entries.body: once more you interfere with the process... why?
entries.source: once more you interfere with the process... why?
entries.translation: 你再度干擾進程…… 為什麼？

entries.label: WHY_YOU_HERE_3
entries.body: your presence here is painful to us... what is it you wish?
entries.source: your presence here is painful to us... what is it you wish?
entries.translation: 你出現在這裡令我們痛 苦……你有何要求？

entries.label: WHY_YOU_HERE_4
entries.body: your presence here is painful to us... what is it you wish?
entries.source: your presence here is painful to us... what is it you wish?
entries.translation: 你出現在這裡令我們痛 苦……你有何要求？

entries.label: find_out_whats_up
entries.body: We came here to find out what you're doing down there.
entries.source: We came here to find out what you're doing down there.
entries.translation: 我們來這裡，是想查明你們 在下面做什麼。

entries.label: HYBRID_PROCESS
entries.body:
though your ship's design is unfamiliar to us
we now understand that you are of human origin and so we will share with you
our reasons for accepting the status of ur-quan slave
in 2135, our great alliance burned within the crucible of sentience
though our fleets of armed starships held back the hierarchy's grotesque armada for many years
in the end, the ur-quan unleashed a power upon us that was so overwhelming
we knew we would be annihilated if we did not submit
this unstoppable power, this ultimate weapon was a huge starship
an unstoppable battle platform built by the precursors in the ancient past
your vessel shares some similarities in design to the ur-quan's battle platform
which they call `sa-matra', meaning `great trophy'
the sa-matra was many times larger than your ship, and bore weapons and defensive systems
that made it invulnerable to all of our technologies
it remains a mystery to us why the ur-quan fought us for so long without using the sa-matra
but when they finally brought the ship into combat
the sa-matra incinerated our finest broodhome vessels from ten times our own ships' weapon range.
we had no choices beyond submission or devastation
before the ur-quan arrived to accept our surrender, we sent one last message to your people
a message suggesting that your species do as we chenjesu and mmrnmhrm planned to do
we would accept the ur-quan's demands and become slaves
until such a time as we found a way to destroy or neutralize the sa-matra.

entries.translation:
儘管你的船艦設計對我們而 言十分陌生
我們現在明白你源自人類， 因此將向你說明
我們為何接受烏爾關奴隸的 身分
2135 年，我們偉大的聯盟在智慧 生命的大熔爐中焚毀
儘管我們的武裝星艦艦隊多 年來一直抵擋階序那怪誕的 大軍
最終烏爾關對我們釋放了一 股壓倒性的力量
我們知道，若不臣服便會遭 到殲滅
這股無法阻擋的力量， 這件終極武器， 是一艘巨型星艦
一座由先驅者在遠古時代建 造、無可阻擋的戰鬥平臺
你的船艦在設計上與烏爾關 的戰鬥平臺有些相似
他們稱它為「薩馬特拉」， 意即「偉大的戰利品」
薩馬特拉比你的船大上許多 倍，並配備武器與防禦系統
使我們所有技術都無法傷它 分毫
烏爾關為何長年與我們交戰 卻不用薩馬特拉， 至今仍是個謎
但當他們終於將這艘船投入 戰鬥時
薩馬特拉在十倍於我方船艦 武器射程的距離外， 便將我們最精良的育巢艦焚 毀。
我們除了臣服或毀滅， 別無選擇
在烏爾關前來接受投降之 前，我們向你們的人民送出 了最後一則訊息
訊息中建議你們的種族採取 我們陳傑蘇與姆爾恩姆赫姆 原本的計畫
我們會接受烏爾關的要求， 成為奴隸
直到找到摧毀或癱瘓薩馬特 拉的方法。

entries.label: need_help
entries.body: We are struggling against the Ur-Quan. Can't you help us?
entries.source: We are struggling against the Ur-Quan. Can't you help us?
entries.translation: 我們正在對抗烏爾關。 你們不能幫助我們嗎？

entries.label: CANT_HELP
entries.body:
we cannot be of any assistance now... we are in the middle of the process.
i will explain
after we chenjesu and mmrnmhrm were defeated by the ur-quan
we chose to be encased in a single slave shield on this world
as soon as the ur-quan departed, we began the process
we initiated a synthesis of our two species, our two cultures
one crystalline, the other purely mechanical
this process, fueled only by the radiant energy of our sun
will eventually produce a new hybrid race
and when the process is complete, we will crack the ur-quan slave shield
and emerge from our chrysalis like a winged insect unleashed from its cocoon
then we will be ready and capable to deal with the ur-quan, their battle thralls
and their dreaded sa-matra.
entries.source:
we cannot be of any assistance now... we are in the middle of the process.
i will explain
after we chenjesu and mmrnmhrm were defeated by the ur-quan
we chose to be encased in a single slave shield on this world
as soon as the ur-quan departed, we began the process

one crystalline, the other purely mechanical
this process, fueled only by the radiant energy of our sun
will eventually produce a new hybrid race
and when the process is complete, we will crack the ur-quan slave shield
and emerge from our chrysalis like a winged insect unleashed from its cocoon
then we will be ready and capable to deal with the ur-quan, their battle thralls
and their dreaded sa-matra.
entries.translation:
我們目前無法提供任何協 助……我們正處於進程之 中。
容我們解釋
陳傑蘇與姆爾恩姆赫姆被烏 爾關擊敗後
我們選擇共同被封在這個世 界的一面奴役護盾之下
烏爾關一離開， 我們便啟動了進程
我們開始合成兩個物種、 兩種文化
一方由晶體構成， 另一方則是純粹的機械
這項進程唯一的燃料， 是太陽的輻射能量
最終將產生一個全新的混合 種族
待進程完成，我們便會打破 烏爾關的奴役護盾
像破繭而出的有翼昆蟲一 般，從蛹中現身
屆時我們就已準備充分， 也有能力應付烏爾關、 他們的戰奴
以及那令人畏懼的薩馬特 拉。

entries.label: why_no_help
entries.body: But why can't you help us now?!
entries.source: But why can't you help us now?!
entries.translation: 但你們為什麼現在不能幫助 我們？！

entries.label: LONG_TIME
entries.body:
the complete synthetic hybridization of the chenjesu and the mmrnmhrm species
will require approximately thirty-five of your earth years
this extended duration is necessary because our synthesis mechanisms
are dependent exclusively on the light of our sun for energy.
entries.source:
the complete synthetic hybridization of the chenjesu and the mmrnmhrm species
will require approximately thirty-five of your earth years
this extended duration is necessary because our synthesis mechanisms
are dependent exclusively on the light of our sun for energy.
entries.translation:
陳傑蘇與姆爾恩姆赫姆兩個 物種的完整合成混種
大約需要三十五個地球年
之所以需要如此漫長的時 間，是因為我們的合成機制
完全依靠太陽光提供能量。

entries.label: what_if_more_energy
entries.body: What if we could find some way to get you more energy? Would that speed things up?
entries.source: What if we could find some way to get you more energy? Would that speed things up?
entries.translation: 如果我們能設法提供更多能 量呢？那會加快進度嗎？

entries.label: DANGER_TO_US
entries.body:
what you describe is theoretically possible
but it would pose a great danger to us
the process must be executed as planned... or it may fail catastrophically
we would be destroyed.
entries.source:
what you describe is theoretically possible
but it would pose a great danger to us
the process must be executed as planned... or it may fail catastrophically
we would be destroyed.
entries.translation:
你所描述的方法在理論上可 行
但會讓我們承受極大的危險
進程必須依照計畫執行…… 否則可能發生災難性的失敗
我們會被摧毀。

entries.label: need_advice
entries.body: We really need advice from you.
entries.source: We really need advice from you.
entries.translation: 我們真的很需要你們的建 議。

entries.label: WHAT_ADVICE
entries.body: our wisdom is available... detail your need.
entries.source: our wisdom is available... detail your need.
entries.translation: 我們的智慧任你取用…… 請詳述你的需求。

entries.label: how_defeat_urquan
entries.body: How do you think we can defeat the Ur-Quan?
entries.source: How do you think we can defeat the Ur-Quan?
entries.translation: 你們認為我們要怎麼擊敗烏 爾關？

entries.label: DEFEAT_LIKE_SO
entries.body:
you must find some way to destroy the sa-matra
to do this you will need a powerful weapon capable of destroying an entire planet
but that is not all
you will also require some way to distract the ur-quan
to give you the opportunity to use the weapon.
entries.source:
you must find some way to destroy the sa-matra
to do this you will need a powerful weapon capable of destroying an entire planet
but that is not all
you will also require some way to distract the ur-quan
to give you the opportunity to use the weapon.
entries.translation:
你必須設法摧毀薩馬特拉
為此，你需要一件足以摧毀 整顆行星的強力武器
但光是這樣還不夠
你還需要某種方法轉移烏爾 關的注意
讓你有機會使用那件武器。

entries.label: what_about_tpet
entries.body: I seem to have acquired a Dnyarri. What do you make of it?
entries.source: I seem to have acquired a Dnyarri. What do you make of it?
entries.translation: 我似乎弄到了一隻迪納里。 你們對它有何看法？

entries.label: SCARY_BUT_USEFUL
entries.body:
we know the dnyarri only from legend
where they are described as the embodiment of evil and cruelty
if ever there was a devil, captain, it was the dnyarri
however, if in fact the creature you possess is one of this ancient breed
its mental power may be useful to help confuse the ur-quan.
entries.source:
we know the dnyarri only from legend
where they are described as the embodiment of evil and cruelty
if ever there was a devil, captain, it was the dnyarri
however, if in fact the creature you possess is one of this ancient breed
its mental power may be useful to help confuse the ur-quan.
entries.translation:
我們只從傳說中得知迪納里
其中描述他們是邪惡與殘酷 的化身
船長，若世上真有惡魔， 那就是迪納里
然而，倘若你擁有的生物確 實屬於這個古老種族
它的精神力量或許有助於擾 亂烏爾關。

entries.label: what_about_bomb
entries.body: I got this huge bomb-thing from a race called the Utwig. Is it really a weapon?
entries.source: I got this huge bomb-thing from a race called the Utwig. Is it really a weapon?
entries.translation: 我從一個叫烏特維格的種族 那裡弄到這個巨型炸彈之類 的東西。它真的是武器嗎？

entries.label: ABOUT_BOMB
entries.body:
the device you speak of is a huge matter-antimatter bomb
if you had activated it, the weapon would have annihilated your ship and everything else within five hundred kilometers
the destructive power of this weapon makes it suitable for the most important task you will ever undertake
the neutralization of the sa-matra, the ur-quan's nearly invincible battle platform.
entries.source:
the device you speak of is a huge matter-antimatter bomb
if you had activated it, the weapon would have annihilated your ship and everything else within five hundred kilometers
the destructive power of this weapon makes it suitable for the most important task you will ever undertake
the neutralization of the sa-matra, the ur-quan's nearly invincible battle platform.
entries.translation:
你所說的裝置是一枚巨型物 質－反物質炸彈
若你啟動它，這件武器會殲 滅你的船，以及方圓五百公 里內的一切
這件武器的破壞力， 使它適合執行你此生最重要 的任務
癱瘓薩馬特拉， 也就是烏爾關那座近乎無敵 的戰鬥平臺。

entries.label: what_about_sun_device
entries.body: I er... borrowed a device from the Mycon. Do you know what it is?
entries.source: I er... borrowed a device from the Mycon. Do you know what it is?
entries.translation: 我呃……從邁康那裡「借」 了一個裝置。你們知道它是 什麼嗎？

entries.label: ABOUT_SUN_DEVICE
entries.body:
we do not recognize this device
but it appears to be a precursor tool which can radiate a great amount of energy.
entries.source:
we do not recognize this device
but it appears to be a precursor tool which can radiate a great amount of energy.
entries.translation:
我們不認得這個裝置
但它似乎是一件能放射大量 能量的先驅者工具。

entries.label: what_about_samatra
entries.body: What more can you tell me about this Sa-Matra?
entries.source: What more can you tell me about this Sa-Matra?
entries.translation: 關於這個薩馬特拉， 你們還能告訴我什麼？

entries.label: ABOUT_SAMATRA
entries.body:
we only glimpsed it once, when it devastated our most powerful fleet
it was several times the size of your vessel
with a host of unusual weapons protruding from its scabrous hull
but the most dangerous feature of the sa-matra was its annihilation toroids...
with this weapon they could vaporize ships from the far side of a solar system
or cut broad swaths of devastation across a planet in seconds.
entries.source:
we only glimpsed it once, when it devastated our most powerful fleet
it was several times the size of your vessel
with a host of unusual weapons protruding from its scabrous hull
but the most dangerous feature of the sa-matra was its annihilation toroids...
with this weapon they could vaporize ships from the far side of a solar system
or cut broad swaths of devastation across a planet in seconds.
entries.translation:
我們只曾在它摧毀我們最強 艦隊時瞥見它一次
它的大小是你船艦的數倍
粗糙的船殼上伸出眾多異常 武器
但薩馬特拉最危險的特徵， 是它的湮滅環面彈……
這種武器能從一個恆星系的 另一端將船艦汽化
或在數秒內於行星表面劃出 一片片寬廣的毀滅地帶。

entries.label: enough_advice
entries.body: Thanks! That's enough advice for now.
entries.source: Thanks! That's enough advice for now.
entries.translation: 謝了！目前這些建議已經夠 了。

entries.label: OK_ENOUGH_ADVICE
entries.body:
though your presence here is a painful intrusion
we will always provide advice whenever you request it, captain.
entries.source:
though your presence here is a painful intrusion
we will always provide advice whenever you request it, captain.
entries.translation:
儘管你的出現是一次令我們 痛苦的侵擾
只要你提出要求， 我們永遠都會提供建議， 船長。

entries.label: bye_shielded
entries.body: Goodbye Chenjesu. Goodbye Mmrnmhrm.
entries.source: Goodbye Chenjesu. Goodbye Mmrnmhrm.
entries.translation: 再見，陳傑蘇。再見， 姆爾恩姆赫姆。

entries.label: GOODBYE_SHIELDED
entries.body:
goodbye once and future ally, human... when the process is complete and we emerge from our chrysalis
i shall tell your grandchildren of our conversation this day.
entries.source:
goodbye once and future ally, human... when the process is complete and we emerge from our chrysalis
i shall tell your grandchildren of our conversation this day.
entries.translation:
再會了，曾是盟友、 未來也會是盟友的人類…… 待進程完成、我們破蛹而出 時
我們會向你的孫輩訴說今日 這場對話。

entries.label: WE_ARE_FREE
entries.body:
WE ARE FREE!
YOU HAVE FLOODED OUR SYNTHESIS MECHANISMS WITH A WEALTH OF RADIANT ENERGY.
WHAT WAS SUPPOSED TO TAKE DECADES HAS BEEN ACCOMPLISHED IN SECONDS.
THE PROCESS IS INCOMPLETE, YET WE HAVE EMERGED.
WE ARE THE CHMMR.
entries.source:
WE ARE FREE!
YOU HAVE FLOODED OUR SYNTHESIS MECHANISMS WITH A WEALTH OF RADIANT ENERGY.
WHAT WAS SUPPOSED TO TAKE DECADES HAS BEEN ACCOMPLISHED IN SECONDS.
THE PROCESS IS INCOMPLETE, YET WE HAVE EMERGED.
WE ARE THE CHMMR.
entries.translation:
我們自由了！
你以大量輻射能量灌滿了我 們的合成機制。
原應耗費數十年的工作， 竟在數秒內完成。
進程尚未完整， 但我們已經現身。
我們是克姆爾。

entries.label: WHO_ARE_YOU
entries.body: WHO ARE YOU?
entries.source: WHO ARE YOU?
entries.translation: 你是誰？

entries.label: i_am_captain0
entries.body: I am captain
entries.source: I am captain
entries.translation: 我是船長

entries.label: i_am_captain1
entries.body: of the starship
entries.source: of the starship
entries.translation: ，隸屬於星艦

entries.label: i_am_savior
entries.body: I am the guy who's trying to save the Galaxy.
entries.source: I am the guy who's trying to save the Galaxy.
entries.translation: 我就是那個試圖拯救銀河系 的人。

entries.label: i_am_silly
entries.body: Who am I? Me? Er... dang! I just forgot.
entries.source: Who am I? Me? Er... dang! I just forgot.
entries.translation: 我是誰？我嗎？呃…… 糟糕！我剛剛忘了。

entries.label: WHY_HAVE_YOU_FREED_US
entries.body: WHY HAVE YOU INTERRUPTED THE PROCESS?!!!
entries.source: WHY HAVE YOU INTERRUPTED THE PROCESS?!!!
entries.translation: 你為什麼要中斷進 程？！！！

entries.label: serious_1
entries.body: We struggle to free all races from the Ur-Quan. We need your help.
entries.source: We struggle to free all races from the Ur-Quan. We need your help.
entries.translation: 我們正努力讓所有種族擺脫 烏爾關。我們需要你們的幫 助。

entries.label: serious_2
entries.body: You are the key to winning back the freedom of our Alliance.
entries.source: You are the key to winning back the freedom of our Alliance.
entries.translation: 你們是讓聯盟重獲自由的關 鍵。

entries.label: silly
entries.body: I wanted to see what you looked like without all that orange junk.
entries.source: I wanted to see what you looked like without all that orange junk.
entries.translation: 我想看看沒有那堆橘色破爛 遮著時，你們長什麼樣子。

entries.label: WILL_HELP_ANALYZE_LOGS
entries.body:
YOUR NEED MUST BE GREAT FOR YOU TO HAVE RISKED SO MUCH
JUST TO BRING US FROM BENEATH THE SHIELD.
WE WERE NOT READY... BUT THIS IS NOW IN THE PAST.
WHAT IS DONE IS DONE.
YOU ARE INTENT ON STOPPING THE UR-QUAN... VERY WELL.
WE ARE PREPARED TO ASSIST YOU IN WHATEVER WAY WE CAN.
WE MUST FIRST TELL YOU THAT EVEN BEFORE WE WERE PLACED UNDER THE SLAVE SHIELD
WE REALIZED THAT THE ONLY WAY TO TRULY DEFEAT THE UR-QUAN
WAS TO FIRST DESTROY THEIR PRECURSOR BATTLE PLATFORM... THE SA-MATRA.
THIS VESSEL WAS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE VICTORY OF THE HIERARCHY OVER THE ALLIANCE.
WHEN IT WAS BROUGHT TO BEAR AGAINST OUR WORLDS, WE COULD NOT RESIST IT.
THIS MUST BE YOUR PRIORITY. THIS MUST BE YOUR EVENTUAL GOAL.
WE KNOW WHAT IS NECESSARY TO ACHIEVE THIS END
BUT FIRST WE MUST KNOW WHAT YOU HAVE ALREADY LEARNED
SO WE WILL SCAN THE DATABANKS AND LOGS ABOARD YOUR SHIP.
THERE.
THE PROCESS IS COMPLETE. NOW WE CAN DISCUSS WHAT YOU MUST DO.

entries.translation:
你的需求必定極為迫切， 才會甘冒如此大的風險
只為將我們從護盾之下帶 出。
我們尚未準備妥當…… 但那已是過去。
事已至此。
你決意阻止烏爾關…… 很好。
我們已準備好以一切可能的 方式協助你。
首先必須告訴你， 甚至在我們被置於奴役護盾 之下以前
我們就已明白， 真正擊敗烏爾關的唯一方法
是先摧毀他們的先驅者戰鬥 平臺……薩馬特拉。
正是這艘船促成階序對聯盟 的勝利。
當它被用來對付我們的世界 時，我們根本無力抵抗。
這必須是你的首要任務。 這必須是你最終的目標。
我們知道達成此事需要什麼
但首先必須知道你已經得知 了什麼
因此我們會掃描你船上的資 料庫與航行紀錄。
完成。
進程已結束。現在可以討論 你必須做的事。

entries.label: YOU_KNOW_SAMATRA
entries.body:
YOU ALREADY HAVE THE DATA NECESSARY TO TELL YOU THAT THE SA-MATRA VESSEL
IS LOCATED IN THE DELTA CRATERIS STAR SYSTEM.
entries.source:
YOU ALREADY HAVE THE DATA NECESSARY TO TELL YOU THAT THE SA-MATRA VESSEL
IS LOCATED IN THE DELTA CRATERIS STAR SYSTEM.
entries.translation:
你已擁有必要的資料， 足以得知薩馬特拉船艦
位於巨爵座德爾塔星系。

entries.label: DONT_KNOW_ABOUT_SAMATRA
entries.body:
YOU NEED TO LOCATE THE UR-QUAN'S SA-MATRA VESSEL.
IF YOU CANNOT FIND IT YOURSELF, ASK THOSE OTHERS WHO ARE NEAR THE UR-QUAN.
PERHAPS THEY WILL KNOW.
entries.source:
YOU NEED TO LOCATE THE UR-QUAN'S SA-MATRA VESSEL.
IF YOU CANNOT FIND IT YOURSELF, ASK THOSE OTHERS WHO ARE NEAR THE UR-QUAN.
PERHAPS THEY WILL KNOW.
entries.translation:
你必須找出烏爾關的薩馬特 拉船艦。
若你無法自行找到它， 就詢問那些鄰近烏爾關的其 他種族。
或許他們會知道。

entries.label: NEED_DISTRACTION
entries.body:
THE SA-MATRA IS SURE TO BE HEAVILY GUARDED.
TO ALLOW YOU TO GET CLOSE ENOUGH TO THE SA-MATRA
YOU WILL HAVE TO CREATE SOME TYPE OF DIVERSION.
entries.source:
THE SA-MATRA IS SURE TO BE HEAVILY GUARDED.
TO ALLOW YOU TO GET CLOSE ENOUGH TO THE SA-MATRA
YOU WILL HAVE TO CREATE SOME TYPE OF DIVERSION.
entries.translation:
薩馬特拉必定受到重兵守 衛。
要讓你能夠接近薩馬特拉
你必須製造某種聲東擊西的 局面。

entries.label: HAVE_TALKING_PET
entries.body:
WE HAVE DETECTED THE PRESENCE OF A DNYARRI ABOARD YOUR SHIP.
THOUGH THE BEING IS DARKLY EVIL, AND INCREDIBLY DANGEROUS
THE TAALO DEVICE YOU POSSESS HAS EFFECTIVELY NULLIFIED THE CREATURE'S POWER OVER YOU.
HOWEVER, IT WILL DO A MOST EXCELLENT JOB DISTRACTING THE UR-QUAN LONG ENOUGH
FOR YOU TO APPROACH THE SA-MATRA AND DESTROY IT.
entries.source:
WE HAVE DETECTED THE PRESENCE OF A DNYARRI ABOARD YOUR SHIP.
THOUGH THE BEING IS DARKLY EVIL, AND INCREDIBLY DANGEROUS
THE TAALO DEVICE YOU POSSESS HAS EFFECTIVELY NULLIFIED THE CREATURE'S POWER OVER YOU.
HOWEVER, IT WILL DO A MOST EXCELLENT JOB DISTRACTING THE UR-QUAN LONG ENOUGH
FOR YOU TO APPROACH THE SA-MATRA AND DESTROY IT.
entries.translation:
我們偵測到你的船上有一隻 迪納里。
儘管這個生物邪惡至極， 而且危險得難以置信
你擁有的塔洛裝置已有效消 除了它對你的控制力。
然而，它會非常有效地轉移 烏爾關的注意，時間足以
讓你接近薩馬特拉並將其摧 毀。

entries.label: NEED_WEAPON
entries.body:
TO DEFEAT THE UR-QUAN YOU MUST FIRST DESTROY THE SA-MATRA BATTLE PLATFORM.
THE ONLY WAY WE CAN ENVISION THIS OCCURRING IS FOR YOU TO DETONATE A HUGE EXPLOSIVE DEVICE
ADJACENT TO THE BATTLE PLATFORM, AT POINT BLANK RANGE.
WE BELIEVE THAT THE ONLY WEAPON WHICH CAN GENERATE SUFFICIENT DESTRUCTIVE FORCE
IS A MATTER-ANTIMATTER BOMB, BUT WE CANNOT BUILD ONE OURSELVES.
entries.source:
TO DEFEAT THE UR-QUAN YOU MUST FIRST DESTROY THE SA-MATRA BATTLE PLATFORM.
THE ONLY WAY WE CAN ENVISION THIS OCCURRING IS FOR YOU TO DETONATE A HUGE EXPLOSIVE DEVICE
ADJACENT TO THE BATTLE PLATFORM, AT POINT BLANK RANGE.
WE BELIEVE THAT THE ONLY WEAPON WHICH CAN GENERATE SUFFICIENT DESTRUCTIVE FORCE
IS A MATTER-ANTIMATTER BOMB, BUT WE CANNOT BUILD ONE OURSELVES.
entries.translation:
要擊敗烏爾關， 你必須先摧毀薩馬特拉戰鬥 平臺。
我們能設想的唯一方法， 是在緊鄰戰鬥平臺之處引爆 一件巨型爆炸裝置
以零距離直接引爆。
我們相信，唯一能產生充足 破壞力的武器
是物質－反物質炸彈， 但我們無法自行製造。

entries.label: HAVE_BOMB
entries.body:
YOU POSSESS AN ANTI-MATTER BOMB. THIS IS GOOD.
BUT HAD YOU ACTIVATED IT, THE DEVICE WOULD HAVE ANNIHILATED YOUR SHIP
AND EVERYTHING ELSE WITHIN FIVE HUNDRED KILOMETERS.
EVEN SO, WE WILL HAVE TO IMPROVE THIS DEVICE, MAGNIFY ITS POWER WITH OUR CRYSTAL TECHNOLOGY.
THE DESTRUCTIVE POTENTIAL OF THIS WEAPON WILL THEN MAKE IT SUITABLE
FOR THE MOST IMPORTANT TASK YOU WILL EVER UNDERTAKE
THE NEUTRALIZATION OF THE SA-MATRA, THE UR-QUAN'S NEARLY INVINCIBLE BATTLE PLATFORM.
entries.source:
YOU POSSESS AN ANTI-MATTER BOMB. THIS IS GOOD.
BUT HAD YOU ACTIVATED IT, THE DEVICE WOULD HAVE ANNIHILATED YOUR SHIP
AND EVERYTHING ELSE WITHIN FIVE HUNDRED KILOMETERS.
EVEN SO, WE WILL HAVE TO IMPROVE THIS DEVICE, MAGNIFY ITS POWER WITH OUR CRYSTAL TECHNOLOGY.
THE DESTRUCTIVE POTENTIAL OF THIS WEAPON WILL THEN MAKE IT SUITABLE
FOR THE MOST IMPORTANT TASK YOU WILL EVER UNDERTAKE
THE NEUTRALIZATION OF THE SA-MATRA, THE UR-QUAN'S NEARLY INVINCIBLE BATTLE PLATFORM.
entries.translation:
你擁有一枚反物質炸彈。 很好。
但你若曾啟動它， 這個裝置會殲滅你的船
以及方圓五百公里內的一 切。
即使如此，我們仍須改良這 個裝置，以晶體科技放大它 的威力。
屆時這件武器的毀滅潛力， 會使它適合執行
你此生最重要的任務
癱瘓薩馬特拉， 也就是烏爾關那座近乎無敵 的戰鬥平臺。

entries.label: RETURN_WHEN_READY
entries.body: RETURN WHEN YOU HAVE GATHERED THE RESOURCES WE HAVE DESCRIBED.
entries.source: RETURN WHEN YOU HAVE GATHERED THE RESOURCES WE HAVE DESCRIBED.
entries.translation: 集齊我們所描述的資源後再 回來。

entries.label: YOU_ARE_READY
entries.body: YOU ARE READY...
entries.source: YOU ARE READY...
entries.translation: 你已準備妥當……

entries.label: further_assistance
entries.body: Can you give us further assistance now?
entries.source: Can you give us further assistance now?
entries.translation: 你們現在能進一步協助我們 嗎？

entries.label: NO_FURTHER_ASSISTANCE
entries.body: WE CANNOT HELP YOU UNTIL YOU HAVE GATHERED THE NECESSARY RESOURCES.
entries.source: WE CANNOT HELP YOU UNTIL YOU HAVE GATHERED THE NECESSARY RESOURCES.
entries.translation: 在你集齊必要資源前， 我們無法協助你。

entries.label: tech_help
entries.body: You seem to have superior technology. Would you share this with us?
entries.source: You seem to have superior technology. Would you share this with us?
entries.translation: 你們似乎擁有更先進的科 技。願意與我們分享嗎？

entries.label: USE_OUR_SHIPS_BEFORE
entries.body:
WE WILL PROVIDE YOU WITH THE DESIGNS FOR A NEW CLASS OF FIGHTING SHIP... THE AVATAR
ALONG WITH ENOUGH CHMMR TO COMMAND HOWEVER MANY VESSELS YOU MAY BUILD.
AVATAR BATTLESHIPS ARE MUCH MORE EFFECTIVE THAN OUR BROODHOME OR X-FORM VESSELS.
IN COMPETENT HANDS, THESE SHIPS CAN DEFEAT ANY SHIP IN SPACE.
entries.source:
WE WILL PROVIDE YOU WITH THE DESIGNS FOR A NEW CLASS OF FIGHTING SHIP... THE AVATAR
ALONG WITH ENOUGH CHMMR TO COMMAND HOWEVER MANY VESSELS YOU MAY BUILD.
AVATAR BATTLESHIPS ARE MUCH MORE EFFECTIVE THAN OUR BROODHOME OR X-FORM VESSELS.
IN COMPETENT HANDS, THESE SHIPS CAN DEFEAT ANY SHIP IN SPACE.
entries.translation:
我們會提供一種新型戰鬥船 艦……化身艦的設計圖
以及足夠的克姆爾船員， 指揮你可能建造的所有船 艦。
化身艦戰艦遠比我們的育巢 艦或變形艦有效。
只要由能力足夠的人操控， 這些船便能擊敗太空中的任 何船艦。

entries.label: where_weapon
entries.body: Where can I find the super-weapon you described?
entries.source: Where can I find the super-weapon you described?
entries.translation: 我可以在哪裡找到你們所說 的超級武器？

entries.label: PRECURSOR_WEAPON
entries.body:
THERE ARE RUMORS OF SUCH A DEVICE, A PRECURSOR PLANETEERING TOOL
TO BE FOUND SOMEWHERE FAR TOWARDS THE CORE
IN THE POSSESSION OF A NON-HOSTILE ALIEN RACE.
WE CANNOT PROVIDE ANY MORE INFORMATION AT THIS TIME.
entries.source:
THERE ARE RUMORS OF SUCH A DEVICE, A PRECURSOR PLANETEERING TOOL
TO BE FOUND SOMEWHERE FAR TOWARDS THE CORE
IN THE POSSESSION OF A NON-HOSTILE ALIEN RACE.
WE CANNOT PROVIDE ANY MORE INFORMATION AT THIS TIME.
entries.translation:
傳聞中有這麼一個裝置， 是一件先驅者的行星工程工 具
位於遙遠的核心方向某處
由一個非敵對的外星種族持 有。
目前我們無法提供更多資 訊。

entries.label: where_distraction
entries.body: What can possibly distract an Ur-Quan?
entries.source: What can possibly distract an Ur-Quan?
entries.translation: 究竟有什麼能轉移烏爾關的 注意？

entries.label: PSYCHIC_WEAPONRY
entries.body:
IN OUR STUDIES WE HAVE LEARNED THAT THE UR-QUAN ARE ESPECIALLY SENSITIVE TO PSYCHIC MANIPULATION.
YOUR BEST STRATEGY WOULD BE TO FIND A WEAPON OF THIS TYPE.
BE AWARE THAT MOST PSYCHIC WEAPONS ARE NOT MECHANICAL CONSTRUCTS.
THEY ARE USUALLY INTELLIGENT LIFE FORMS, OFTEN INIMICAL.
entries.source:
IN OUR STUDIES WE HAVE LEARNED THAT THE UR-QUAN ARE ESPECIALLY SENSITIVE TO PSYCHIC MANIPULATION.
YOUR BEST STRATEGY WOULD BE TO FIND A WEAPON OF THIS TYPE.
BE AWARE THAT MOST PSYCHIC WEAPONS ARE NOT MECHANICAL CONSTRUCTS.
THEY ARE USUALLY INTELLIGENT LIFE FORMS, OFTEN INIMICAL.
entries.translation:
研究顯示，烏爾關對精神操 控格外敏感。
你最好的策略， 是找到一件此類武器。
請注意，大多數精神武器並 非機械構造物。
它們通常是智慧生命體， 而且往往懷有敵意。

entries.label: what_now
entries.body: So what happens now?
entries.source: So what happens now?
entries.translation: 那現在要做什麼？

entries.label: WE_WILL_IMPROVE_BOMB
entries.body:
YOU ARE FULLY PREPARED FOR THE UNDERTAKING.
THERE IS EVERY CHANCE THAT YOU WILL BE ABLE TO DESTROY THE SA-MATRA
AND STOP BOTH THE UR-QUAN AND THE KOHR-AH.
entries.source:
YOU ARE FULLY PREPARED FOR THE UNDERTAKING.
THERE IS EVERY CHANCE THAT YOU WILL BE ABLE TO DESTROY THE SA-MATRA
AND STOP BOTH THE UR-QUAN AND THE KOHR-AH.
entries.translation:
你已為這項任務做好萬全準 備。
你完全有機會摧毀薩馬特拉
並阻止烏爾關與克爾阿雙 方。

entries.label: MODIFY_VESSEL
entries.body:
WE WILL NOW FIT THE PRECURSOR WEAPON AND OUR OWN CRYSTAL AMPLIFICATION SYSTEM TO YOUR VESSEL.
BY ROUTING A PORTION OF YOUR FLAGSHIP'S FUSION POWER THROUGH THE WEAPON'S IGNITION CHAMBER
ITS DESTRUCTIVE FORCE WILL BE MULTIPLIED BY A LARGE FACTOR.
entries.source:
WE WILL NOW FIT THE PRECURSOR WEAPON AND OUR OWN CRYSTAL AMPLIFICATION SYSTEM TO YOUR VESSEL.
BY ROUTING A PORTION OF YOUR FLAGSHIP'S FUSION POWER THROUGH THE WEAPON'S IGNITION CHAMBER
ITS DESTRUCTIVE FORCE WILL BE MULTIPLIED BY A LARGE FACTOR.
entries.translation:
現在我們會把先驅者武器與 自己的晶體增幅系統裝上你 的船艦。
只要將旗艦的一部分核融合 動力導入武器的點火室
它的破壞力便會獲得大幅倍 增。

entries.label: wont_hurt_my_ship
entries.body: We'll fire this weapon at the Sa-Matra, right? It's not going to hurt my ship, is it?
entries.source: We'll fire this weapon at the Sa-Matra, right? It's not going to hurt my ship, is it?
entries.translation: 我們要把這件武器射向薩馬 特拉，對吧？它不會傷到我 的船吧？

entries.label: WILL_DESTROY_IT
entries.body: YOUR VESSEL WILL BE TOTALLY ANNIHILATED.
entries.source: YOUR VESSEL WILL BE TOTALLY ANNIHILATED.
entries.translation: 你的船艦將被徹底殲滅。

entries.label: bummer_about_my_ship
entries.body: Whoa. Gee, that's bad. I don't suppose there's anything we can do to change that, is there?
entries.source: Whoa. Gee, that's bad. I don't suppose there's anything we can do to change that, is there?
entries.translation: 哇。天啊，那可糟了。 我想我們沒辦法改變這點， 對吧？

entries.label: DEAD_SILENCE
entries.body: NO.
entries.source: NO.
entries.translation: 不。

entries.label: other_assistance
entries.body: Can you provide us with any other assistance?
entries.source: Can you provide us with any other assistance?
entries.translation: 你們還能提供其他協助嗎？

entries.label: USE_OUR_SHIPS_AFTER
entries.body:
BECAUSE YOUR FLAGSHIP WILL BE SUBSTANTIALLY WEAKENED BY OUR MODIFICATIONS
YOU MAY REQUIRE ADDITIONAL COMBAT VEHICLES FOR PROTECTION
SO THAT YOU CAN APPROACH CLOSE ENOUGH TO THE SA-MATRA TO DETONATE THE WEAPON.
WE WILL PROVIDE YOU WITH THE DESIGNS FOR OUR NEW AVATAR-CLASS FIGHTING SHIPS.
IN COMPETENT HANDS, THESE SHIPS ARE A MATCH FOR BOTH THE UR-QUAN AND KOHR-AH VESSELS.
entries.source:
BECAUSE YOUR FLAGSHIP WILL BE SUBSTANTIALLY WEAKENED BY OUR MODIFICATIONS
YOU MAY REQUIRE ADDITIONAL COMBAT VEHICLES FOR PROTECTION
SO THAT YOU CAN APPROACH CLOSE ENOUGH TO THE SA-MATRA TO DETONATE THE WEAPON.
WE WILL PROVIDE YOU WITH THE DESIGNS FOR OUR NEW AVATAR-CLASS FIGHTING SHIPS.
IN COMPETENT HANDS, THESE SHIPS ARE A MATCH FOR BOTH THE UR-QUAN AND KOHR-AH VESSELS.
entries.translation:
由於我們的改裝會大幅削弱 你的旗艦
你可能需要額外的戰鬥載具 提供保護
才能充分接近薩馬特拉並引 爆武器。
我們會提供新型化身艦級戰 鬥船艦的設計圖。
只要由能力足夠的人操控， 這些船足以抗衡烏爾關與克 爾阿的船艦。

entries.label: proceed
entries.body: Very well. Proceed with the modifications.
entries.source: Very well. Proceed with the modifications.
entries.translation: 很好。開始改裝吧。

entries.label: TAKE_2_WEEKS
entries.body:
THE COMPLETION DATE FOR YOUR VESSEL'S MODIFICATION IS ROUGHLY TWO WEEKS HENCE.
SO THAT YOU AND YOUR HUMAN COMPANIONS MAY MAKE ANY NECESSARY PREPARATIONS AT YOUR STARBASE
WE WILL NOW TRANSPORT YOU AND YOUR CREW BACK TO EARTH IMMEDIATELY.
GOOD LUCK, CAPTAIN.
entries.source:
THE COMPLETION DATE FOR YOUR VESSEL'S MODIFICATION IS ROUGHLY TWO WEEKS HENCE.
SO THAT YOU AND YOUR HUMAN COMPANIONS MAY MAKE ANY NECESSARY PREPARATIONS AT YOUR STARBASE
WE WILL NOW TRANSPORT YOU AND YOUR CREW BACK TO EARTH IMMEDIATELY.
GOOD LUCK, CAPTAIN.
entries.translation:
你的船艦改裝完成日期， 大約是在兩週後。
為了讓你與人類同伴能在星 際基地進行任何必要的準備
現在我們會立刻將你與船員 送回地球。
祝你好運，船長。

entries.label: HELLO_AFTER_BOMB_1
entries.body: WE GREET YOU HUMAN CAPTAIN. WHAT DO YOU NEED FROM US?
entries.source: WE GREET YOU HUMAN CAPTAIN. WHAT DO YOU NEED FROM US?
entries.translation: 向你致意，人類船長。 你需要我們做什麼？

entries.label: HELLO_AFTER_BOMB_2
entries.body: WELCOME BACK HUMAN. WHY HAVE YOU RETURNED?
entries.source: WELCOME BACK HUMAN. WHY HAVE YOU RETURNED?
entries.translation: 歡迎回來，人類。 你為何返回？

entries.label: whats_up_after_bomb
entries.body: Have you learned anything new since I was here last?
entries.source: Have you learned anything new since I was here last?
entries.translation: 自從我上次來過之後， 你們有得到任何新消息嗎？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_AFTER_BOMB_1
entries.body:
YES. WE HAVE REACHED TWO CONCLUSIONS
ONE: THE LOCATION OF THE SA-MATRA CAN BE CONFINED TO THE STARS IN THE CRATERIS CONSTELLATION.
SEEK THE VEHICLE IN THIS REGION.
TWO: BECAUSE THE UR-QUAN LOST SO MANY SHIPS WHEN THE SHOFIXTI CAUSED THEIR OWN SUN TO FLARE
THE KOHR-AH'S FORCES ARE GROSSLY SUPERIOR TO THE UR-QUAN.
IF THE WAR IS NOT OVER BETWEEN THE UR-QUAN AND THE KOHR-AH, IT SHALL BE SOON, WITH THE KOHR-AH VICTORIOUS.
WHEN THIS HAPPENS THE KOHR-AH WILL MOVE THROUGH SPACE
DESTROYING ALL INTELLIGENT RACES ONE BY ONE UNTIL NONE REMAIN.
YOU MUST NOT BE DISTRACTED! THE SA-MATRA IS THE KEY TO THEIR DOMINANCE!
DESTROY THEIR SACRED TROPHY, AND UNITED WITH OUR ALLIES, WE CAN DEFEAT THEIR STAR FLEET.
entries.source:
YES. WE HAVE REACHED TWO CONCLUSIONS
ONE: THE LOCATION OF THE SA-MATRA CAN BE CONFINED TO THE STARS IN THE CRATERIS CONSTELLATION.
SEEK THE VEHICLE IN THIS REGION.
TWO: BECAUSE THE UR-QUAN LOST SO MANY SHIPS WHEN THE SHOFIXTI CAUSED THEIR OWN SUN TO FLARE
THE KOHR-AH'S FORCES ARE GROSSLY SUPERIOR TO THE UR-QUAN.
IF THE WAR IS NOT OVER BETWEEN THE UR-QUAN AND THE KOHR-AH, IT SHALL BE SOON, WITH THE KOHR-AH VICTORIOUS.
WHEN THIS HAPPENS THE KOHR-AH WILL MOVE THROUGH SPACE
DESTROYING ALL INTELLIGENT RACES ONE BY ONE UNTIL NONE REMAIN.
YOU MUST NOT BE DISTRACTED! THE SA-MATRA IS THE KEY TO THEIR DOMINANCE!
DESTROY THEIR SACRED TROPHY, AND UNITED WITH OUR ALLIES, WE CAN DEFEAT THEIR STAR FLEET.
entries.translation:
有。我們得出了兩項結論
一：薩馬特拉的位置可限縮 在巨爵座的恆星之中。
在這片區域尋找該載具。
二：索菲克斯提引發自己的 太陽閃焰時，烏爾關損失了 太多船艦
因此克爾阿的兵力遠遠凌駕 於烏爾關。
若烏爾關與克爾阿之戰尚未 結束，也很快就會由克爾阿 獲勝。
屆時克爾阿將穿越太空
逐一摧毀所有智慧種族， 直到一個也不剩。
你絕不能分心！ 薩馬特拉是他們維持霸權的 關鍵！
摧毀他們的神聖戰利品， 再與我們的盟友會合， 我們便能擊敗他們的星際艦 隊。

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_AFTER_BOMB_2
entries.body:
WE HAVE TOLD YOU EVERYTHING WE KNOW.
GO TO THE CRATERIS CONSTELLATION. FIND THE SA-MATRA. USE THE POWERS OF THE DNYARRI.
DESTROY THE SA-MATRA!
entries.source:
WE HAVE TOLD YOU EVERYTHING WE KNOW.
GO TO THE CRATERIS CONSTELLATION. FIND THE SA-MATRA. USE THE POWERS OF THE DNYARRI.
DESTROY THE SA-MATRA!
entries.translation:
我們已告訴你所知道的一 切。
前往巨爵座。找到薩馬特 拉。運用迪納里的力量。
摧毀薩馬特拉！

entries.label: what_do_after_bomb
entries.body: So NOW what do I do?
entries.source: So NOW what do I do?
entries.translation: 那我現在到底該怎麼辦？

entries.label: DO_AFTER_BOMB
entries.body:
SEEK THE LOCATION OF THE SA-MATRA. FLY THERE WITH GREATEST SPEED!
USE THE POWERS OF THE DNYARRI, AND WHILE THE UR-QUAN ARE IN CHAOS, DESTROY THE SA-MATRA!
entries.source:
SEEK THE LOCATION OF THE SA-MATRA. FLY THERE WITH GREATEST SPEED!
USE THE POWERS OF THE DNYARRI, AND WHILE THE UR-QUAN ARE IN CHAOS, DESTROY THE SA-MATRA!
entries.translation:
找出薩馬特拉的位置。 以最快速度飛往那裡！
運用迪納里的力量， 趁烏爾關陷入混亂時摧毀薩 馬特拉！

entries.label: bye_after_bomb
entries.body: I'll see you when it's over, I hope.
entries.source: I'll see you when it's over, I hope.
entries.translation: 希望事情結束後， 我還能再見到你們。

entries.label: GOODBYE_AFTER_BOMB
entries.body: YOU ARE PREPARED. WITH COURAGE AND FORTUNE AT YOUR SIDE YOU WILL BE VICTORIOUS.
entries.source: YOU ARE PREPARED. WITH COURAGE AND FORTUNE AT YOUR SIDE YOU WILL BE VICTORIOUS.
entries.translation: 你已準備妥當。 只要勇氣與幸運相伴， 你就會勝利。

entries.label: bye
entries.body: Farewell. We will be back when we've got everything we need.
entries.source: Farewell. We will be back when we've got everything we need.
entries.translation: 再會。等我們備妥所需的一 切，就會回來。

entries.label: GOODBYE
entries.body: WE AWAIT YOUR RETURN.
entries.source: WE AWAIT YOUR RETURN.
entries.translation: 我們等候你歸來。
